description: All listing (classifieds) sections and categories — vehicles, real estate, jobs, services, electronics, home, fashion, kids, hobbies, animals, food, business, education, community, people (co-founders, teammates, travel companions…) — with names in the requested language, the number of active listings, and structured fields: each section's `fields` (e.g. vehicles: make, model, year, mileage_km, fuel; real estate: deal, property, rooms, area_m2; jobs: employment, salary_min/max, salary_period); a category with a finer set of its own names it in `fieldset`, whose fields are listed once in `fieldsets`. Fields marked money are amounts in the listing's currency; a field's help is a hint for the person (an example, not a value to fill in). A section's note says what to ask the person before posting there — follow it. Use the category slug and its fields in search_listings (filters) or post_listing (attributes).
name: list_listing_categories
title: Listing categories
